physicalPlan.execution: One reactor processes the command list serially; each send completes before the next command is sent.
physicalPlan.condition: ownerBecomesAdministrator = CreatorIsAdministrator OR FirstAdministratorEmail is null.

orderedEffects.intent: Register the tenant owner for the administrator episode.
Link the administrators team to the administrator role.
Commit all three core administrator permissions.
Assign the exact owner member to the administrators team; TeamMemberAssigned can trigger tenant activation.

physicalPlan.activationFence: The order-6 TeamMemberAssigned effect is forbidden until the order-4 TeamRoleAssigned fact and all three order-5 RolePermissionAssigned facts have committed for this same tenant registration and administrator role.
physicalPlan.failureBehavior: Any prerequisite send failure stops before activation assignment; activation assignment failure fails the reactor invocation and prevents its checkpoint from completing. Replays reuse the same source-derived command identities.
